text:
maria-ops: Acme Health escalated invoice OH-2026-0421. Their AP is confused by two platform-related lines, asking for confirmation before processing payment.

sam-fin: I checked the export. Totals equal the SOW, but we emitted PLATFORM_SERVICE and a negative PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ. Need to confirm whether that negative is an approved migration credit.

kelly-ar: Can you paste the relevant invoice lines? If AP sees two separate GL descriptions they'll post two entries and delay. We usually include net wording.

maria-ops: Snippet: 
```
Line 12: PLATFORM_SERVICE - $120,000 - SKU: PF-ENT-2025
Line 13: PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ - ($12,000) - SKU: PF-LEGACY-CREDIT
Line 14: SUPPORT_TIER_GOLD - $30,000 - SKU: SUP-GOLD
Total due: $138,000
```
AP says "PLATFORM_LEGACY_ADJ" isn't labeled as an approval or contract credit.

sam-fin: That ($12k) matches the migration credit we approved for legacy-to-new billing consolidation. Need the approval record ID to share.

kelly-ar: Found AR note: Approval APPR-2025-1128 by Jordan CS for $12,000 "Platform consolidation credit - Acme Health" dated 2025-12-18. AR has the PDF.

jordan-cs: Confirmed. I approved APPR-2025-1128. I can send a confirmation email to Acme AP and cc billing.

billing-bot: Billing export 2026-04-20 completed. Rule: PF-LEGACY-CREDIT emits as separate negative line. Created ticket BILL-7842.

sam-fin: Action list: 1) @kelly-ar attach APPR-2025-1128 PDF here, 2) @billing-ops reissue OH-2026-0421 with consolidated line "Platform Fee (net of migration credit)" and memo "APPR-2025-1128" OR send a cover letter with the approval, 3) I'll update GL mapping so AR posts to a single platform revenue account.

kelly-ar: Uploading the approval PDF to AR (internal link omitted). Filename: APPR-2025-1128-Acme-PlatformCredit.pdf.

billing-bot: BILL-7842 assigned to @billing-ops. ETA to reissue corrected invoice: 2 business days. Will include consolidated description and reference ID.

maria-ops: Great. I'll notify Acme AP that a corrected invoice and approval email are coming so payment isn't held. Thanks everyone. :pray:
